name: Michelle Garside
reason: Mainly a brand strategist and memoir writer rather than a spiritual teacher (her paid work is brand intensives, speech writing and a client circle, and her book openly argues against chasing awakening), and too thin once the rules are applied: her Omega workshop (22 Oct 2026) has passed, her book is not out until February 2027, her April 2027 1440 Multiversity weekend links only to a hotel booking engine with no page of its own, the Marrakech trip sits on a separate co-founded brand site, and she has no YouTube channel.
